visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium shot of a man with wavy dark hair, wearing a tan hooded jacket over a white textured sweater. He sits in a wood-paneled indoor restaurant and uses a red spoon to scoop a thick, dark green viscous substance from a black ceramic bowl. (2) Wide shot transition to the exterior of a traditional Japanese building with dark wood beams and a courtyard. A large, manicured pine tree is central, and a wooden informational sign stands on a stone path under a cloudy sky. (3) Close-up shot focusing on the black bowl where a hand stirs the thick green paste. The texture appears highly concentrated and semi-solid, clinging to the red wooden spoon as it is lifted. (4) Medium shot of the man reacting with high-energy facial expressions, squinting and gesturing dramatically with his hands toward his face. In the background, a woman sits at a nearby table. (5) Close-up of another man wearing a black beanie and a black jacket, smiling and speaking directly. Then a cut to a woman in a white coat looking stunned while holding a bowl. (6) Close-up of a bamboo section container filled with a dessert topped with white cream and a green cross pattern. A spoon digs in to reveal layers of sponge cake, red bean, and white ice cream.
